extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: 1980s wedge sports car, approx. 4.4 x 1.8 x 1.23 m (L x W x H incl. mirrors and rear wing), wheel diameter 0.62 m
extras.notes: front faces -Y; generic 1980s wedge design with raised pop-up headlights, black plastic bumpers and rear wing; 4 wheels are separate objects with origin on the hub (rotate around local X to roll); hollow cabin with transparent windows, two bucket seats and steering wheel; no brand, no logo, no text

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
